approach: Add a thin I/O layer in scope_guard.rs: build RequestRecords from Records (attempt = closed request job; unmet criterion = first criterion with met=false in the verification; cost = spent_usd(); agent minutes = sum of invocation wall time; plan size and round from the latest JobPlan; retry_of from the "try again on <id>" request; quotes = known job ids in request text), group with group_lines, and call evaluate_before_attempt. Persist per-line flags and any pause record {signal, numbers, lift, at} as one JSON file per line under the state dir (pattern of disk::write_hold). Athena::go runs the watcher after a job finishes (never touches the registry or any process). dispatch in run.rs and Athena::retry refuse a paused line with the pause reason. status() gains a scope_guard list; display.rs prints it. A pause lifts only when a new request is not linked to the paused line (a narrowed request starts a new line); no close-path cleanup. Criteria 1-3 are proved by tests that drive Athena::go through the test_support fixture, so removing a hook fails them.

decisions.choice: Store flags and pause records as JSON files in the state directory, keyed by the line's first job id, read and written only by scope_guard.rs.
decisions.reason: No athena-data record type is on the deliverable list; a new type needs schema, validators and docs. The disk hold already uses this pattern. Overwriting by key avoids duplicate flags.

rejected.option: New athena.scope-pause record in athena-data and records/
rejected.why: Touches the schema crate and docs outside the deliverables; too large for one run.

rejected.option: Derive the pause on every check with no stored record
rejected.why: Criterion 1 needs a pause record to exist, and later threshold changes would silently lift old pauses.

decisions.choice: The pause record names the strongest signal (Pause beats Flag; ties go to the lowest number) and lists the numbers of every signal at Pause.
decisions.reason: One clear reason per refusal; status still shows every tripped signal.

rejected.why: More files and a harder message with no extra information.

decisions.choice: Lift text: T4 asks for a measurement of the target or a narrowed request (a new, unlinked ask); T3 and T5 a measurement of remaining cost or time; T2 a smaller plan. No resume command. A pause is lifted only by the narrowed request starting a new line; no pause file is deleted on close.
decisions.reason: Matches section 5 and removes the unlisted close-path change (finding 5). A lift command is not requested.

rejected.option: Delete the pause file when the paused job is closed
rejected.why: Needs a change to the close path, which is not a listed file, and could hide a live pause.

decisions.choice: Run the watcher in the Finished arm of Athena::go (run.rs:144) beside introspect_job; check the pause at the top of dispatch (run.rs:322) and in Athena::retry. Watcher errors are logged through ui and never returned.
decisions.reason: The Finished arm already hosts non-blocking follow-ups. Nothing touches the registry kill path, so running jobs are never stopped. dispatch is where a job starts, so the check applies only to the next attempt.

rejected.why: It holds the job lock and commits records; a watcher failure could affect the job outcome.

decisions.choice: Keep one call to scope_guard::refuse_if_paused in Athena::retry in reading.rs, before ask, and list reading.rs as a file touched (finding 1). The logic stays in scope_guard.rs.
decisions.reason: Athena::retry is defined at reading.rs:699 and commits a 'try again on' request through ask; criterion 3 needs retry itself to refuse, and no listed file contains it. The edit is one call plus a test-free import.

rejected.why: retry would still commit a new request, failing criterion 3.

decisions.choice: T3 forecast p90 is passed as 0.0 (documented as not used by t3_cost) unless an existing per-class source is readable from records.

Behavior tests for criteria 1-3 live in athena-core and use the test_support fixture (`athena(&self, capabilities, script)`, as run_pin_tests.rs does) to run go to Finished; the direct unit tests of watch_after_attempt and refuse_if_paused are kept as extras.
decisions.reason: Calling the functions directly would pass even if the hooks in go and dispatch were removed (finding 2).

rejected.why: Cannot fail when a hook is missing.

files.purpose: Watcher: build line records from Records, evaluate, write and read flag and pause files, refuse_if_paused, pause text builders, tests.
Call the watcher in go after Finished (errors logged only); call the pause check at the top of dispatch; end-to-end tests may sit beside run_pin_tests.
One call to scope_guard::refuse_if_paused in Athena::retry before ask. retry is defined here, in none of the listed files; the edit is outside the listed deliverables and needed for criterion 3.
Add LineSignalView and a scope_guard list to StatusView; fill it from the stored flags and pauses; test.
Print flagged and paused lines with signal, numbers and lift; test.
Unreleased entry for the running-line watcher.
Section 13: mark job 5 built; record where pauses live and how they lift.

steps: Read Records accessors: JobRecords::state, verification criteria, spent_usd, invocation wall_time, plans, and the retry request form in reading.rs; read run_pin_tests.rs and test_support.rs for the fixture.
In scope_guard.rs add request_records(records), line lookup, and LineState with serde.
Add PauseRecord {signal, numbers, lift, at} and text builders for T1-T5.
Add watch_after_attempt(state, records, job_id), writing <state>/scope-guard/<line-head>.json; no process or registry calls.
Add refuse_if_paused returning an error with signal, numbers and lift.
Call the watcher in go after Finished (errors logged only); call refuse_if_paused at the top of dispatch and in Athena::retry before ask.
Add LineSignalView and scope_guard to StatusView; fill it in status().
Write the fixture-driven tests for criteria 1-3 and 6, the direct unit tests, the status test and the display test.
Update CHANGELOG.md and docs/design/scope-guard.md; run fmt, clippy and test.

risks.mitigation: Match only full job ids that exist in Records; test with an unrelated id.

risks.risk: A stale pause blocks a line with no way to lift.
risks.mitigation: The refusal names the lift; a narrowed request starts a new line. Say so in the docs; no automatic cleanup.

risks.risk: Watcher I/O failure breaks go or hides the result.
risks.mitigation: Run after the result is computed; log errors via ui and never return them.
Key the file by the line's first job id and overwrite it on each evaluation.
Reuse the existing constants; the pause text states the numbers.

risks.risk: End-to-end fixture tests are harder to script than direct calls.
risks.mitigation: Reuse the run_pin_tests fixture pattern; if scripting verifier rejections proves hard, a minimal Records-based helper is added in test_support.

demonstrations.method: Test in athena-core using the test_support fixture with a scripted capability and a verifier that rejects with the same unmet criterion (digits differing). Run go on job 1, retry-link job 2 ('try again on'), run go on it, then go on the third 'try again on' job.
demonstrations.observes: After the second go a pause file exists with signal T4; the third go returns Err containing the pause reason and records no new invocation.
demonstrations.fails_without: Without the watcher call in go, no pause file is written after job 2; without the check in dispatch, the third go proceeds and records an invocation. Either removal fails the assertions.

demonstrations.method: Same fixture; two linked rejections with differing unmet criteria; go on the third 'try again on' job.
demonstrations.observes: A T1 flag is stored, no pause file exists, and the third go dispatches and records an invocation.
demonstrations.fails_without: If every flag were treated as a pause, the third go would be refused; if go did not run the watcher, the T1 flag file would be missing.

demonstrations.method: Test in athena-core: with a pause stored from the end-to-end setup, call Athena::retry on a job in the paused line and on a rejected job in another line.
demonstrations.observes: The paused call returns Err containing the signal, the numbers and the lift text, and the record count is unchanged; the unpaused call returns Ok.
demonstrations.fails_without: Without the refuse_if_paused call in Athena::retry, 'try again on <job>' is asked and committed, failing the Err and record-count assertions.

demonstrations.method: Two named tests. status_scope_guard in crates/athena-core/src/status.rs writes one T1 flag and one T4 pause file and asserts status() fills StatusView.scope_guard with both, signal and job id included. display_scope_guard in crates/athena-cli (display.rs tests) renders a StatusView holding both entries.
demonstrations.command: cargo test --locked status_scope_guard && cargo test --locked display_scope_guard
demonstrations.observes: The rendered text contains T1 with 'flag', T4 with 'pause', and each line's job id; with no entries nothing extra is printed.
demonstrations.fails_without: If status() did not read the stored files, the first test finds an empty list; if display.rs did not print them, the second finds no signal lines.

demonstrations.method: Test builds pause records for a T4 pause and a T3 pause through the watcher and reads the stored JSON back.
demonstrations.observes: Signal, numbers (rejection count and criterion texts for T4; spend and p90 for T3) and lift text (mentions a narrowed request for T4, a measurement for T3) are non-empty and match the inputs.
demonstrations.fails_without: An empty or generic pause record fails the field assertions.

demonstrations.method: Test registers a running job on a paused line and runs the watcher to a Pause, asserting the job is still running. It also stores a pause, then runs go on a job already Dispatched on that line through the fixture. CHANGELOG.md is read for the entry (git diff).
demonstrations.observes: The registry still shows the first job running and no signal is sent; the already dispatched job reaches its terminal state and its outcome is recorded; git diff shows an Unreleased CHANGELOG.md entry naming the running-line watcher.
demonstrations.fails_without: If the pause path signalled or killed the running job, its registry state would change; if the pause check sat anywhere but at dispatch, the already dispatched job could not reach its terminal state through go.

demonstrations.method: Run the lint and format checks over the whole change including the new tests.
demonstrations.observes: Both commands exit zero with no warnings.
demonstrations.fails_without: Any unformatted code, unused item or lint in the new watcher, status or display code makes a command exit non-zero.

open_questions: reading.rs is not among the deliverables but holds Athena::retry; a one-call edit there is needed for criterion 3. Confirm this is acceptable.
Whether a measurement alone can lift a T4 pause without a new command is unsettled; the plan lifts only by a new unlinked narrowed request.
Where a per-kind forecast p90 can be read from existing records was not checked; fallback is 0.0.
The unit of invocation wall_time for agent minutes was not checked.
